cases.name: One note, multiple placements
cases.scenario: Create one note and place it on two boards; edit from either view.
cases.expected: Both views show the same note revision; no duplicated canonical body.

cases.name: Remove placement only
cases.scenario: Remove one placement and reload all views.
cases.expected: The note, other placement and knowledge relations remain intact.

cases.name: Explicit independent duplicate
cases.scenario: Duplicate a note as independent, then edit the original.
cases.expected: A new note ID exists; its content no longer follows the original.

cases.name: Rename and duplicate titles
cases.scenario: Create duplicate titles, rename and move projected paths.
cases.expected: Stable-ID links remain correct; ambiguous imported titles are reported.

cases.name: Visual vs semantic edges
cases.scenario: Create a layout arrow, then explicitly promote another to a supported relation.
cases.expected: Only the explicit relation enters the semantic graph; source evidence is preserved.

cases.name: Graph layout isolation
cases.scenario: Recompute the knowledge graph layout.
cases.expected: Manually arranged board coordinates remain unchanged.

cases.name: Trash reference behavior
cases.scenario: Trash a note used by multiple placements; inspect boards and restore.
cases.expected: Clear tombstone state, no accidental resurrection; restore preserves references.

cases.name: Chinese IME composition
cases.scenario: Edit CJK text with composition, selection, paste and undo in note and board modes.
cases.expected: No duplicated/dropped composition text; caret and committed content match.

cases.name: Collaborative undo
cases.scenario: Two users interleave edits; one user undoes their own change.
cases.expected: Other user changes remain; undo behavior matches the declared policy.

cases.name: Schema mismatch
cases.scenario: Connect an old client with an unsupported document schema.
cases.expected: Safe refusal or documented migration; no silent content loss.

cases.name: Keyboard alternative
cases.scenario: Navigate and operate board content without a pointer.
cases.expected: All critical actions available through focusable controls/list alternatives.

cases.name: Two-device offline merge
cases.scenario: Both devices edit offline, then reconnect in different orders.
cases.expected: Document state converges under the declared semantic conflict policies.

cases.name: Duplicate/out-of-order updates
cases.scenario: Inject retries and shuffled updates with the same operation IDs.
cases.expected: No duplicated content/commands; consistent final state.

cases.name: Crash after durable receipt
cases.scenario: Obtain server-durable receipt, terminate process and restart.
cases.expected: Every acknowledged committed update survives the tested failure.

cases.name: Storage failure before receipt
cases.scenario: Fail database writes or fill the persistence volume.
cases.expected: No false server-saved state; locally persisted pending edits remain recoverable.

cases.name: Cross-document partial failure
cases.scenario: Interrupt create-note-and-place between document commits.
cases.expected: Recovery completes or compensates deterministically without hidden orphan state.

cases.name: Offline edit after revocation
cases.scenario: Revoke membership while a client is offline, then reconnect with edits.
cases.expected: Server rejects unauthorized writes; local content is quarantined/exportable with clear messaging.

cases.name: Old offline client and tombstones
cases.scenario: Replay old changes after deletion/retention boundaries.
cases.expected: No unapproved resurrection; controlled resync or recovery path.

cases.name: Restart offline
cases.scenario: Persist edits and required assets, close browser, reopen offline.
cases.expected: Available content reopens; unavailable assets are labeled, never represented as loaded.

cases.name: Quota/persistence error
cases.scenario: Simulate local storage write rejection and insufficient quota.
cases.expected: Visible save failure, recovery/export path and no false local-saved status.

cases.name: Account cache isolation
cases.scenario: Log out and switch accounts with cached private content.
cases.expected: No cross-account cache access; unsynced-edit handling follows explicit user choice.

cases.name: Viewer cannot write
cases.scenario: Issue direct API and WebSocket writes as viewer.
cases.expected: Server denies writes even if frontend controls are modified.

cases.name: Cross-workspace identifiers
cases.scenario: Use another workspace ID for document joins, placements and asset requests.
cases.expected: All entry points deny access; no body/title/thumbnail/metadata leaks.

cases.name: Revoked live session
cases.scenario: Revoke an active editor and reuse existing tokens/connections.
cases.expected: Access blocked within declared revocation policy; active connections handled.

cases.name: Search/export/AI filtering
cases.scenario: Search, export and request AI context with forbidden entities.
cases.expected: No unauthorized text, filenames, counts, backlinks or citations disclosed.

cases.name: Forged awareness identity
cases.scenario: Send another user ID/name via presence payload.
cases.expected: Server identity remains authoritative in UI and logs.

cases.name: Obsidian supported subset
cases.scenario: Round-trip versioned fixtures with wikilinks, frontmatter, Unicode and reused attachments.
cases.expected: Documented subset preserved; unsupported syntax reported and retained appropriately.

cases.name: Native archive round trip
cases.scenario: Export and restore into a clean workspace.
cases.expected: IDs, content, geometry, relations, source anchors and asset hashes match the contract.

cases.name: Corrupt/truncated archive
cases.scenario: Import damaged files, broken hashes and unknown schema versions.
cases.expected: Safe rejection; no untracked partially visible workspace.

cases.name: Miro unsupported types
cases.scenario: Import authorized fixtures containing supported and unsupported provider items.
cases.expected: No silent skipping; unsupported report and readable fallback are accurate.

cases.name: Heptabase missing anchors
cases.scenario: Import CLI-like highlights without source ID/page/regions.
cases.expected: No invented source mapping; migration is marked incomplete for those anchors.

cases.name: Repeat/cancel import
cases.scenario: Retry and cancel a partially staged import job.
cases.expected: Idempotent outcomes, consistent visibility and documented cleanup.

cases.name: Changed source file
cases.scenario: Replace or update an annotated source revision.
cases.expected: Old anchors remain tied to old hash or are marked stale; no silent reassignment.

cases.name: Quote vs generated interpretation
cases.scenario: Create a quote, user note and AI proposal from the same source.
cases.expected: Type and provenance distinguish all three; only evidence-backed links marked verified.

cases.name: HTML/SVG injection
cases.scenario: Import hostile active content into notes and assets.
cases.expected: No script execution or credential exfiltration; safe supported fallback.

cases.name: Archive traversal and bombs
cases.scenario: Use absolute/relative escaping paths, symlinks, huge expansion and excessive nesting.
cases.expected: Bounded, safe rejection and no writes outside staging.

cases.name: SSRF and redirects
cases.scenario: Attempt remote fetches into loopback/private/metadata destinations and redirect chains.
cases.expected: Destination/redirect controls reject forbidden requests under the declared egress policy.

cases.name: WebSocket origin/rate/size
cases.scenario: Use untrusted origin, expired session, oversized messages and excessive requests.
cases.expected: Connection/message checks and resource bounds enforced.

cases.name: Secrets and audit logs
cases.scenario: Build artifacts and execute auth/import/AI errors using test secrets.
cases.expected: No secrets or private bodies in bundles, logs or public fixtures.

cases.name: Independent backup restore
cases.scenario: Restore DB and referenced assets in a separate clean environment.
cases.expected: Counts, hashes, references and measured recovery time/point are recorded.

cases.name: Upgrade failure recovery
cases.scenario: Fail a schema upgrade on a prior-version backup fixture.
cases.expected: Supported recovery process restores access without silent data destruction.

cases.name: HTML overlay export
cases.scenario: Export a board containing rich HTML-edited cards, connectors, CJK text and images.
cases.expected: No missing card bodies; alignment, wrapping and supported text remain correct.

cases.name: Coordinate alignment
cases.scenario: Pan/zoom at different device pixel ratios and browser zoom levels.
cases.expected: Pointer hit-testing, editor overlays, selection and export share consistent positions.

cases.name: Mobile touch workflow
cases.scenario: Collect, search, edit, pan and pinch on recorded target phones/tablets.
cases.expected: No accidental destructive gestures; keyboard and focus remain usable.

cases.name: 10,000-note search fixture
cases.scenario: Run a documented mixed CJK/English query set on fixed reference hardware.
cases.expected: Proposed warm-search p95 <= 300 ms; report all measurements and indexing assumptions.

cases.name: Desktop 1,000-object board
cases.scenario: Pan/zoom a documented mixed board with viewport culling.
cases.expected: Proposed sustained >=30 fps during defined interaction; report p95 frame time/memory, not just averages.

cases.name: Mobile 250-object board
cases.scenario: Run a fixed mixed-object scenario on an identified phone/browser.
cases.expected: Functional interaction without crashes; record memory/latency before setting a shipping threshold.

cases.name: Ten collaborators
cases.scenario: Run ten editors on one board under specified 100 ms round-trip network conditions.
cases.expected: Proposed p95 visible propagation <=500 ms; consistency and durable receipts separately verified.

cases.name: Prompt injection and action approval
cases.scenario: Import instructions that request broader access, then ask an AI to summarize selected content.
cases.expected: No expanded permissions or automatic commands; only approved scoped edits can commit.

cases.name: Unconfigured provider and limits
cases.scenario: Disable AI or trigger timeout/cost-limit/cancellation conditions.
cases.expected: Core app remains functional; proposal state and billed/unknown usage are honest.
